mapper.select: SELECT c.child_id AS childId, c.birth_status AS birthStatus, c.expected_birth_date AS expectedBirthDate, c.birth_date AS birthDate FROM child c WHERE c.child_id = #{childId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child_parent cp JOIN child c ON c.child_id = cp.child_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN member m ON m.member_id = cp.member_id AND m.member_type = 'PARENT' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE cp.member_id = #{memberId} AND cp.child_id = #{childId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO child_checklist_item ( child_id, checklist_item_template_id, status, completed_by_member_id, completed_at, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{childId}, template.checklist_item_template_id, 'PENDING', NULL, NULL, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM checklist_item_template template WHERE template.lifecycle_stage = #{lifecycleStage} AND template.is_active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT progress.child_checklist_item_id AS checklistItemId, template.checklist_item_template_id AS checklistItemTemplateId, template.title AS title, template.description AS description, progress.status AS status, progress.completed_at AS completedAt, template.item_order AS itemOrder FROM child_checklist_item progress JOIN checklist_item_template template ON template.checklist_item_template_id = progress.checklist_item_template_id WHERE progress.child_id = #{childId} AND template.lifecycle_stage = #{lifecycleStage} AND template.is_active = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN progress.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, template.item_order ASC, template.checklist_item_template_id ASC
